source: Local authorized Docker labs only; no invented metric values

definition.recall: true positive matches / known exploitable local-lab vulnerabilities
definition.report_success_rate: successfully exported validated reports / all eligible findings
definition.evidence_bundle_completeness: closed verified evidence bundles / eligible findings
definition.scan_runtime_seconds: elapsed monotonic seconds, median over identical lab snapshots

measurement_policy: No green gate with null values. Save timestamped comparable results to benchmarks/history only with actual tool/test output.
